When two users edit the same document at the same time, the second save sometimes overwrites the first user's changes without any warning. We use optimistic locking, so this should not happen, but it does, roughly once in a few hundred saves. I dug into the code and found that the version check happens before the lock is acquired, not after. So there is a window of about 500 milliseconds under load, where both saves pass the check. The fix is to move the check inside the transaction. I have a patch ready, but I would like someone to review it carefully, because it touches the core save path. I also wrote a test that reproduces the race by running two saves in parallel. The test fails before the patch and passes after.

If people are interested, I can write a one page proposal and we can try it next quarter. No pressure, I just wanted to put the idea out there.
